address: Building 2, No. 5199, North Section of Binhai Avenue, Longwan, Wenzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: This seafood restaurant, which sports a dockside theme, has earned wide acclaim with its home-style Wenzhou dishes. A magnificent lineup of seafood shipped straight from the port is displayed at the entrance – yellow croaker, white shrimp, freshwater crab, sea anemone, razor clams... You can take your pick or ask the server for recommendations and ways to prepare. Prices are reasonable and the cooking highlights natural flavours.
